claim:
Let \(C\sim\operatorname{LKJ}_n(\eta)\) with \(n\ge 3\), \(\eta>0\), and \(
u=n+2\eta-1\). For any three distinct off-diagonal entries, \(\mathbb E[C_{e_1}C_{e_2}C_{e_3}]=
u^{-2}\) exactly when the three unordered edges form one triangle, and the expectation is \(0\) otherwise. Consequently the off-diagonal entries, although pairwise independent, are not three-wise independent, and \(\mathbb E\,\operatorname{tr}((C-I_n)^3)=n(n-1)(n-2)/
u^2\). If \(\eta_n/n	o	heta\in[0,\infty)\), then \(n^{-1}\mathbb E\,\operatorname{tr}((C-I_n)^3)	o(1+2	heta)^{-2}\), the third centered moment of the corresponding Marchenko--Pastur limit.

integrity.computational_role: Numerical simulation was used only as a stress check and is not part of the proof.
integrity.proof_basis: Exact conditional-density symmetry, sign invariance, published LKJ pairwise independence, and the published marginal second moment.
integrity.source_boundary: The originality comparison distinguishes the exact third-order triangle identity from prior first- and second-moment results.

scientific_limitations: The theorem identifies the complete third moment for triples of distinct off-diagonal coordinates, but not the full higher-order joint law.
No fluctuation theorem or concentration estimate for the cubic trace is claimed.
A residual literature risk remains for older joint-moment formulas for Gaussian sample correlations written in different notation.
title: Exact triangle cumulants reveal the first hidden dependence in LKJ correlation matrices
